hints.title: Player Installation and Day One Retention
hints.text: Determine the earliest installation date for each player, then check if they logged activity exactly one day later.

hints.title: Install Date Aggregation with Next-Day Outer Join
hints.text: Group activity by player to find min event date. Left join with activity matching player identifier and event date plus one day.

hints.title: Retention Calculation Blueprint
hints.text: with Installs as (select player_id, min(event_date) as install_dt from Activity group by player_id) select i.install_dt, count(i.player_id) as installs, round(count(a.player_id) / count(i.player_id), 2) as Day1_retention from Installs i left join Activity a on i.player_id = a.player_id and a.event_date = date_add(i.install_dt, interval 1 day) group by i.install_dt.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH Installs AS (
    SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS install_dt
    FROM Activity
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT i.install_dt,
       COUNT(i.player_id) AS installs,
       ROUND(COUNT(a.player_id) / COUNT(i.player_id), 2) AS Day1_retention
FROM Installs i
LEFT JOIN Activity a
  ON i.player_id = a.player_id
 AND a.event_date = DATE_ADD(i.install_dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY i.install_dt;
```

complexity.notes: Grouped min aggregation followed by next-day equi-join runs in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated scalar queries checking day-one logins per player incur quadratic scans across activity records.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Common table expression precomputes installation cohorts, enabling single-pass join filtering.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of DATE_ADD for exact single-day offset and LEFT JOIN to preserve zero retention cohorts.

    FROM Activity
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT i.install_dt,
       COUNT(i.player_id) AS installs,
       ROUND(COUNT(a.player_id)::numeric / COUNT(i.player_id), 2) AS "Day1_retention"
FROM Installs i
LEFT JOIN Activity a
  ON i.player_id = a.player_id
 AND a.event_date = i.install_dt + INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY i.install_dt;

solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def gameplay_analysis(activity: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    installs = activity.groupby('player_id')['event_date'].min().reset_index()
    installs.rename(columns={'event_date': 'install_dt'}, inplace=True)
    activity['next_day'] = activity['event_date'] - pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    merged = installs.merge(activity, left_on=['player_id', 'install_dt'], right_on=['player_id', 'next_day'], how='left')
    res = merged.groupby('install_dt').agg(
        installs=('player_id', 'nunique'),
        retained=('event_date', 'count')
    ).reset_index()
    res['Day1_retention'] = (res['retained'] / res['installs']).round(2)
    return res[['install_dt', 'installs', 'Day1_retention']]
solutions.approach: Pandas Groupby Minimum and Offset Merge
